blocks.title: Origin
blocks.text: ADAN Empower is a federally funded pilot project that shows what works against anti-Black racism in access to the job market. For its launch, the project needed a mark and a voice that make a complex offer easy to approach.

blocks.caption: Brand guidelines board · logo, palette, typography and applications

blocks.title: Concept & design decisions
blocks.text: Above the wordmark, an open, fragmented outline in signal orange; below it, “Empower” sits on a slightly tilted label, like a stamp of approval. From the mark came the key visuals, carousels for Instagram and LinkedIn and a set of templates the team now uses itself: complex topics broken into clear steps, held together by one orange line.
